ref_file_title: BCG+20 - Efficient Pseudorandom Correlation Generators from Ring-LPN
authors: Elette Boyle, Geoffroy Couteau, Niv Gilboa, Yuval Ishai, Lisa Kohl, Peter Scholl
note: Verified against vendor/cryptobib entry C:BCGIKS20 (CRYPTO 2020, pp. 387-416, doi 10.1007/978-3-030-56880-1_14) and eprint 2022/1035. Abstract: 'we design a new class of efficient PCGs based on different flavors of the ring-LPN assumption', giving silent OLE and authenticated multiplication triples. cryptobib_key: C:BCGIKS20.

authors: Elette Boyle, Geoffroy Couteau, Niv Gilboa, Yuval Ishai
note: ACM CCS 2018, pp. 896-912; cryptobib CCS:BCGI18 (verified in vendor/cryptobib); full version eprint 2019/273. Defines multi-point FSS (MPFSS) and constructs it from DPFs via combinatorial batch codes.

authors: Lennart Braun, Geoffroy Couteau, Kelsey Melissaris, Mahshid Riahinia, Elahe Sadeghi

ref_file_title: BCMS20 - Recursive Proof Composition from Accumulation Schemes
authors: Benedikt Bünz, Alessandro Chiesa, Pratyush Mishra, Nicholas Spooner

authors: Elette Boyle, Kai-Min Chung, Rafael Pass

ref_file_title: BDH11 - XMSS A Practical Forward Secure Signature Scheme Based on Minimal Security Assumptions
authors: Johannes Buchmann, Erik Dahmen, Andreas Hülsing
note: Verified offline in vendor/cryptobib: PQCrypto 2011, pp. 117-129, DOI 10.1007/978-3-642-25405-5_8; ePrint 2011/484. Proves EU-CMA and forward security from a second-preimage-resistant hash function family and a pseudorandom function family.

ref_file_title: BDJR97 - A Concrete Security Treatment of Symmetric Encryption
authors: Mihir Bellare, Anand Desai, Eric Jokipii, Phillip Rogaway
note: cryptobib FOCS:BDJR97 (FOCS 1997, pp. 394-403, doi 10.1109/SFCS.1997.646128).
